name: pool-maintenance
//: The budget of this repository's declared pool maintenance (onevcs.toml, the justfile's pool-maintenance recipe): budgets.yaml and the measure.sh it runs. Its one budget is labelled host, so it runs in the repo-uniform budgets-host target; measure.sh builds the workspace twice, so check and the affected run select only `-t budgets`, never budgets-host, and `just budgets-host` (which ci.yml's release-PR sweep runs) is the one recipe that reaches it. The gate tiers reach only its format, lint and test, the journeys of measure.sh over a scratch workspace. It depends on nothing: the journeys build no crate of this workspace.

options.command: bash tools/coverage/shcov.sh run pool-maintenance -- bun test --timeout 600000 pool-maintenance/tests

test.//: measure.sh over a one-crate scratch workspace with the real justfile recipe, cargo and the pinned cargo-prune-superseded: a backlog cleared untimed, the alternative build removed by the timed pass and the ordinary build kept; and its refusals, before anything builds.
